items.text: Samuel Oschin Air and Space Center
Pedestrian plaza from the Science Center to the CAAM entry
CAAM, 1984 (Haywood and Proby). About 46,000 sf traced, 44,000 sf published.
Garden and path from the south parking lot (OSM)
ITERATION 1: SITE. Exposition Park, south-east corner. Traced from OpenStreetMap, drawn at 1/4 sheet scale. Not surveyed.
Plaza face: one straight 45-degree wall, about 335 ft long
Entry drum: half-round canopy, 20 ft radius, four round columns
West pavilion, projecting into the plaza
Stepped east wall along Figueroa Street
ITERATION 2: TRACED FOOTPRINT AND GROUND SHELL (1/4"=1'-0"). Traced from OSM at about 0.8 ft a pixel; within 2 ft at best. Walls 16 in block (assumed).
Bleacher steps along the court glass (photo p1)
ITERATION 3: GROUND FLOOR PROGRAM (1/4"=1'-0"). Rooms from the published list, placed by assumption. Footprint ~46,400 sf traced; 44,000 sf published.
Glazed court roof, +26 ft at the plaza rising to +42 ft
ITERATION 4: ROOF PLAN (1/4"=1'-0"). Flat roofs at assumed heights, the sloped glazed court roof, the tower and drum. Section A at x = 180 ft.
ITERATION 5: PLAZA ELEVATION, FIRST PASS (1/4"=1'-0"). Looking south-east at the 45-degree face. Massing only, heights assumed.
Split-face block walls, warm grey (photo p1)
Stepped tower, three tiers to about 46 ft
Drum canopy, red lettering on concrete (p1)
Sculpture court glass over bleacher steps
Glazed court roof seen rising behind
ITERATION 6: PLAZA ELEVATION, SECOND PASS (1/4"=1'-0"). Curtain walls, block coursing, entry drum and columns, bleacher steps. The face chosen for the iso.
Blank block walls on Figueroa (assumed: no photo of this side)
Court roof and tower seen over the offices
EAST ELEVATION ON FIGUEROA STREET (1/4"=1'-0"). Looking west; north on the right.
Glazed space-frame roof, falling to the plaza
Sculpture court, about 26 to 38 ft high here
SECTION A AT X = 180 FT, LOOKING WEST (1/4"=1'-0"). Galleries, sculpture court, plaza glass and steps.
ITERATION 7: EAST ELEVATION AND SECTION A.

speech.text: Iteration 1. Site from the OpenStreetMap tiles: the south-east corner of Exposition Park, State Drive, Figueroa Street, the Air and Space Center, and the plaza that meets the museum on a 45-degree face.
Iteration 2. The traced footprint as a ground shell: 250 by 349 feet, the long plaza face, the entry drum, the pavilion and the stepped Figueroa wall.
Iteration 3. Program on the ground floor: three galleries, the theater gallery, lobby, sculpture court, library, offices and conference room, each with its traced area.
Iteration 4. Roof plan: flat roofs at assumed heights, the sloped glazed court roof, the stepped tower, the drum and section line A.
Iteration 5. Plaza elevation, first pass: the block model drawn far to near, massing only.
Iteration 6. Plaza elevation, second pass: curtain walls, block coursing, the drum and its columns, the steps. This face is chosen for the isometric.
Iteration 7. East elevation on Figueroa Street, and section A through the galleries and the sculpture court.
